title: Assimil - French with Ease (113 lessons)
how_bot_uses_it: Lesson text chunked from the PDF into DB table assimil_lessons; bot generates native-voice TTS for the dialogue and sends as a Telegram voice note. Passive wave: listen + read + repeat. Active wave (from lesson 50): bot sends English lines, you reply in French, bot checks.

title: RFI - Journal en français facile (daily 10-min news)
how_bot_uses_it: From month 3: bot sends the episode link + 5 pre-listening vocab cards + 3 comprehension questions (TCF style) as a quiz afterwards. Transcripts on the site allow reading follow-up.

title: InnerFrench podcast (Hugo Cotton)
how_bot_uses_it: Month 4+. Intermediate comprehensible input, slow clear French with transcripts.

title: Français Authentique (Johan)
how_bot_uses_it: Month 2-4 bridge between Assimil and RFI.

title: TV5MONDE Apprendre le français (exercises by level)
how_bot_uses_it: Seated slot on weak-skill days; bot links a level-appropriate series.

title: Bot-generated TCF-style practice sets
how_bot_uses_it: Gemini writes a short passage/dialogue at the target CLB on a TCF theme, TTS renders audio, bot sends 3-4 MCQ as Telegram quiz cards. Also generates writing prompts (tasks 1-3) and speaking prompts (tasks 1-3) from the exam model.

title: In-bot spaced repetition (FSRS)
how_bot_uses_it: Cards created automatically from each Assimil lesson, from grading error logs, and from TCF theme word lists. Reviews pushed 3x/day as inline-button cards.

title: Shadowing / chorusing (polyglot method)
how_bot_uses_it: Bot sends the Assimil dialogue at slow then normal speed; you speak simultaneously. Weekly: send back a voice note of one dialogue for pronunciation feedback.
